newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - AMR Corp Q1 EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - AMR Corp Q1 EPS view cut.

text.p: -- NatWest Securities said it lowered its first quarter earnings estimate on AMR Corp to $1.45 a share from $1.85 a share.
-- cited traffic shortfall for seven to 10-day period before American's brief pilots strike. Said American Airlines' traffic dropped 4.9 percent and capacity fell 3.0 percent in February.
-- said raised the first quarter unit cost forecast to $0.0985 per available seat mile from $0.0945 per available seat mile.
-- said maintains the second quarter earnings estimate of $3.20 a share.
-- said American's advanced bookings for March and April have bounced back quickly and are ahead of last year.
